content:
Manchester United have bolstered their midfield with the acquisition of Uruguayan international Manuel Ugarte from Paris Saint-Germain in a high-stakes move signaling the club’s intent to rebuild with tenacity and vision. Finalized on Friday evening for an initial €50 million (£42 million), the deal could rise to €60 million with performance-based add-ons, underscoring United’s commitment to securing top-tier talent. The 23-year-old has committed to the club with a five-year contract, featuring an optional extension of an additional year.

Ugarte, known for his combative style, tactical intelligence, and reliability in shielding defenses, joins manager Erik ten Hag’s growing roster of strategic reinforcements this transfer window. His arrival marks the fifth significant addition under the Dutch boss, further reshaping a squad aiming to reclaim its position among Europe’s elite. The signing adds essential depth and competition in the defensive midfield role, positioning Ugarte as a long-term partner to veteran Casemiro.

Speaking after completing the formalities, Ugarte expressed his deep admiration for the club’s legacy and global stature. “It is an incredible feeling to join a club of this magnitude – one that is admired all around the world,” he said. “The project that the football leadership discussed with me is extremely exciting. Manchester United is an ambitious club and I am an ambitious player.” With palpable enthusiasm, Ugarte looked ahead to embracing the famed Old Trafford atmosphere and uniting with teammates in pursuit of silverware. “I know how incredible United fans are and I cannot wait to experience Old Trafford. I’m someone who is so determined to succeed. I will sacrifice and give everything for my teammates. Together we will fight to win trophies and reach the level where this club needs to be.”

Dan Ashworth, United’s sporting director, confirmed that Ugarte had been a key priority in the summer strategy. “Signing Manuel was another of our primary targets for this summer. His profile perfectly aligns with the attributes we value—discipline, leadership, and a relentless drive to improve. He brings youth, vitality, and the kind of competitive edge essential for the challenges that lie ahead.”

Ugarte’s emergence as a consistent performer at PSG, where he earned plaudits despite limited starting opportunities, convinced United’s leadership team of his potential to thrive under pressure. His background with Uruguay’s national team, including appearances in high-pressure tournaments, adds international pedigree to a United midfield seeking stability and resilience.

As preparations continue for the upcoming season, Ugarte’s integration is expected to be swift, with ten Hag keen to build a balanced midfield unit capable of dominating games both defensively and in transition. With Old Trafford hungry for a return to triumph, Ugarte’s promise to “fight for trophies” resonates as both a personal vow and a collective mission.
